trait.mastertrait.blazing.name: Blazing
trait.mastertrait.blazing.desc:
Deals +{damage}% damage to burning enemies.
Each level of Fire Aspect adds +{damagePerFireAspect}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.insect_crusher.name: Insect Crusher
trait.mastertrait.holy_armament.name: Holy Armament
trait.mastertrait.void_bane.name: Void Bane
trait.mastertrait.slaughter.name: Slaughter
trait.mastertrait.slaughter.desc: Deals +{damage}% damage to illagers and villagers.
trait.mastertrait.deadly_discipline.name: Deadly Discipline
trait.mastertrait.deadly_discipline.desc: Deals +{damage}% damage for each debuff on the target.
trait.mastertrait.wound_destroyer.name: Wound Destroyer
trait.mastertrait.wound_destroyer.desc:
Each hit on the same target grants +{damage}% damage (max +{maxDamage}%).
Resets after {resetSeconds}s without hitting the target.
trait.mastertrait.will_of_the_ocean.name: Will of the Ocean
trait.mastertrait.will_of_the_ocean.desc: While in water +{damage}% damage and +{damageReduction}% damage reduction.
trait.mastertrait.rain_dance.name: Rain Dance
trait.mastertrait.rain_dance.desc:
Rain +{rainDamage}% damage and +{rainAttackSpeed}% attack speed.
Thunderstorm +{thunderDamage}% damage and +{thunderAttackSpeed}% attack speed.
trait.mastertrait.doom_slayer.name: Doom Slayer
trait.mastertrait.doom_slayer.desc:
In the Nether deals +{netherDamage}% damage.
Elsewhere deals -{otherwiseDamage}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.light_absorb.name: Light Absorb
trait.mastertrait.light_absorb.desc: Deals +{damage}% damage while standing in direct sunlight.
trait.mastertrait.maximum_might.name: Maximum Might
trait.mastertrait.menacing.name: Menacing
trait.mastertrait.menacing.desc: With {minMobs}+ hostile mobs within {range} blocks, hostile mobs deal {damageReduction}% less damage.
trait.mastertrait.duelist.name: Duelist
trait.mastertrait.duelist.desc:
With exactly one hostile mob within {range} blocks deals +{damage}% damage.
Otherwise deals -{penalty}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.peak_performance.name: Peak Performance
trait.mastertrait.peak_performance.desc: After {seconds} seconds without taking damage deals +{damage}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.mount_master.name: Mount Master
trait.mastertrait.mount_master.desc: While riding deals +{damage}% damage and takes {damageReduction}% less damage.
trait.mastertrait.immovable_object.name: Immovable Object
trait.mastertrait.immovable_object.desc: While standing still {damageReduction}% damage reduction and +{knockbackResistance}% knockback resistance.
trait.mastertrait.steadfast.name: Steadfast
trait.mastertrait.steadfast.desc: While sneaking +{attackSpeed}% attack speed and {knockbackResistance}% knockback resistance.
trait.mastertrait.well_fed.name: Well Fed
trait.mastertrait.well_fed.desc: While your hunger bar is full +{criticalChance}% Critical Chance and +{criticalDamage}% Critical Damage.
trait.mastertrait.masochist.name: Masochist
trait.mastertrait.masochist.desc: Gain {damageReductionPerDebuff}% damage reduction for each debuff on you.
trait.mastertrait.lone_wolf.name: Lone Wolf
trait.mastertrait.lone_wolf.desc:
With no players, villagers or wolves within {range} blocks +{damage}% damage and +{healing}% healing received.
Otherwise -{penalty}% damage and -{penalty}% healing received.
trait.mastertrait.vanquished_soul.name: Vanquished Soul
trait.mastertrait.vanquished_soul.desc: Gain +{criticalChance}% Critical Chance against enemies below {healthBelow}% health.
trait.mastertrait.giant_slayer.name: Giant Slayer
trait.mastertrait.giant_slayer.desc:
Target max health below yours -{penalty}% damage.
Target max health above yours +{bonus}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.overwhelming.name: Overwhelming
trait.mastertrait.overwhelming.desc:
Target max health above yours -{penalty}% damage.
Target max health below yours +{bonus}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.grand_strike.name: Grand Strike
trait.mastertrait.grand_strike.desc: Deals +{damage}% damage to targets at full health.
trait.mastertrait.unstable_blade.name: Unstable Blade
trait.mastertrait.unstable_blade.desc: Each hit deals {minPercent}% to {maxPercent}% of its normal damage.
trait.mastertrait.emerald_obsession.name: Emerald Obsession
trait.mastertrait.emerald_obsession.desc: Each emerald in your inventory grants +{damagePerEmerald}% damage (max +{maxDamage}%).
trait.mastertrait.satsujinki.name: Satsujinki
trait.mastertrait.satsujinki.desc: Each mob killed with this weapon grants +{damagePerKill}% damage (max +{maxDamage}%).
trait.mastertrait.massacred.name: Massacred
trait.mastertrait.massacred.desc: Every mob killed grants +{damagePerStack}% damage (max +{maxDamage}%) for {seconds} seconds.
trait.mastertrait.critical_eyes.name: Critical Eyes
trait.mastertrait.night_edge.name: Night Edge
trait.mastertrait.sky_striker.name: Sky Striker
trait.mastertrait.tempered.name: Tempered
trait.mastertrait.light_weight.name: Light Weight
trait.mastertrait.glass_cannon.name: Glass Cannon
trait.mastertrait.berserker_soul.name: Berserker Soul
trait.mastertrait.berserker_soul.desc: Below {healthBelow}% health take {damageReduction}% less damage and gain +{rage}% Rage.
trait.mastertrait.vampirism.name: Vampirism
trait.mastertrait.wither_hand.name: Wither Hand
trait.mastertrait.wither_hand.desc:
Hits inflict Wither ({witherSeconds}s).
Gain {lifesteal}% Lifesteal against withered targets.
trait.mastertrait.venomous_edge.name: Venomous Edge
trait.mastertrait.venomous_edge.desc: Deal +{damagePerPoisonLevel}% damage per level of poison on poisoned targets.
trait.mastertrait.bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
trait.mastertrait.wicked_rune.name: Wicked Rune
trait.mastertrait.wicked_rune.desc:
Killing a mob deals {damagePercent}% of its max health (+{percentPerProtectionLevel}% per level of Blast, Fire and Projectile Protection on your armor) to mobs within {range} blocks (+1 block per {levelsPerRange} levels).
Players, pets and villagers in range take {fixedDamage} damage.
trait.mastertrait.midas_touch.name: Midas Touch
trait.mastertrait.midas_touch.desc: Killing a mob has a {chance}% chance (+{chancePerLooting}% per Looting level) to drop gold, double its experience and grant Absorption I for {absorptionSeconds}s.
trait.mastertrait.solo_leveling.name: Solo Leveling
trait.mastertrait.solo_leveling.desc: No other players within {range} blocks +{experience}% bonus experience from kills.
trait.mastertrait.hell_forged.name: Hell Forged
trait.mastertrait.hell_forged.desc:
Immune to fire and lava damage. Hits set enemies on fire for {fireSeconds}s.
In the Nether +{netherCriticalDamage}% Critical Damage.
trait.mastertrait.rampager.name: Rampager
trait.mastertrait.rampager.desc:
Each hit grants +{attackSpeedPerHit}% attack speed (max {maxAttackSpeed}%).
Resets after {resetSeconds}s without hitting.
trait.mastertrait.tempest.name: Tempest
trait.mastertrait.tempest.desc:
When struck by lightning, gain Resistance, Strength, Night Vision and Fire Resistance for {seconds}s.
You take double damage from lightning.
trait.mastertrait.party_leader.name: Party Leader
trait.mastertrait.party_leader.desc:
Villagers within {range} blocks gain +{damage}% damage, +{damageReduction}% damage reduction and Speed I.
You cannot hurt villagers.
trait.mastertrait.know_my_name.name: Know My Name
trait.mastertrait.know_my_name.desc:
Other players within {range} blocks deal +{damage}% damage and take {damageReduction}% less damage.
Cannot be stacked.
trait.mastertrait.united.name: United
trait.mastertrait.united.desc: Deals +{damagePerPlayer}% damage for each other player within {range} blocks who also holds United.
trait.mastertrait.golden_rule.name: Golden Rule
trait.mastertrait.golden_rule.desc:
Gain +{experience}% bonus experience from kills.
Doubled while wearing a full set of gold armor.
trait.mastertrait.holy_chant.name: Holy Chant
trait.mastertrait.holy_chant.desc:
Say "Lord of Light, bless this blade
and smite the wicked" in chat,
gain Strength I for {strengthSeconds}s.
Strength is lost if you stop holding the weapon.
CD {cooldownSeconds:min} (-{cooldownReductionPerSmite}s per level of Smite).
trait.mastertrait.curse_extract.name: Curse Extract
trait.mastertrait.curse_extract.desc: Deals +{damage}% damage for each curse enchantment you carry.
trait.mastertrait.beast_tamer.name: Beast Tamer
trait.mastertrait.beast_tamer.desc: Your wolves within {range} blocks gain +{damage}% damage, {damageReduction}% damage reduction, +{speed}% speed and grow {sizeBonus}% larger.
trait.mastertrait.engineer.name: Engineer
trait.mastertrait.engineer.desc:
Iron golems within {range} blocks gain +{damage}% damage and +{damageReduction}% damage reduction.
A golem that takes {damageThreshold}% of its max health in {windowSeconds}s heals {healPercent}% of the total max health of hostile mobs within {healRadius} blocks of it (bosses not counted). CD {cooldownSeconds:min}.
trait.mastertrait.corpse_eater.name: Corpse Eater
trait.mastertrait.corpse_eater.desc: Killing a mob has a {chance}% chance to restore {hunger} hunger.
trait.mastertrait.scavenger.name: Scavenger
trait.mastertrait.scavenger.desc: Killing a mob repairs {durability} durability on every piece of your armor.
trait.mastertrait.titans_vigor.name: Titan's Vigor
trait.mastertrait.titans_vigor.desc: Each point of max health grants +{damagePerHealth}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.helm_breaker.name: Helm Breaker
trait.mastertrait.moonlit_edge.name: Moonlit Edge
trait.mastertrait.moonlit_edge.desc: Deals +{damage}% damage on a full moon night.
trait.mastertrait.counterstrike.name: Counterstrike
trait.mastertrait.counterstrike.desc: After blocking or taking a hit, your next hit within {seconds}s deals +{damage}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.momentum.name: Momentum
trait.mastertrait.momentum.desc: While sprinting, hits deal +{damagePerSecond}% damage per second sprinted (max +{maxDamage}%). Resets when you hit.
trait.mastertrait.banner_bearer.name: Banner Bearer
trait.mastertrait.banner_bearer.desc: Allies within {range} blocks gain +{movementSpeed}% movement speed and +{attackSpeed}% attack speed.
trait.mastertrait.bounty_hunter.name: Bounty Hunter
trait.mastertrait.bounty_hunter.desc: Killing a mob with {minMaxHealth}+ MaxHP drops {expMultiplier}x experience, grants {levels} levels and 2 random rewards.
trait.mastertrait.phial_blade.name: Phial Blade
trait.mastertrait.phial_blade.desc:
{chance}% on hit apply random effect to player for {seconds}s. CD {cooldownSeconds:min}.
Each Sweeping Edge level +{chancePerSweeping}% chance, +{durationPerSweeping}s effect duration and one fewer possible debuff.
At Sweeping Edge {shareLevel} allies {shareRange} blocks nearby apply same effect for {shareSeconds}s.
trait.mastertrait.illuminating.name: Illuminating
trait.mastertrait.illuminating.desc: Deals +{damagePerLevel}% damage per enchantment level on this weapon.
trait.mastertrait.spikey.name: Spikey
trait.mastertrait.spikey.desc: Reflects {reflect}% of the damage to the attacker (+{reflectPerThorns}% per level of Thorns on your armor).
trait.mastertrait.fortitude.name: Fortitude
trait.mastertrait.shock_absorber.name: Shock Absorber
trait.mastertrait.shock_absorber.desc: Each block builds a stack. When you lower the shield, nearby mobs are knocked back and take (stacks x {damagePerStack}) + Unbreaking level damage.
trait.mastertrait.bulwark.name: Bulwark
trait.mastertrait.iron_bastion.name: Iron Bastion
trait.mastertrait.iron_bastion.desc:
Each block grants +{damageReductionPerBlock}% damage reduction (max {maxDamageReduction}%).
Lost when you lower the shield or {resetSeconds}s pass without a block.
trait.mastertrait.perfect_guard.name: Perfect Guard
trait.mastertrait.perfect_guard.desc:
{chance}% chance when blocking the attacker gets Slowness {slownessLevel} for {seconds}s.
For {debuffSeconds}s it deals {damageDealtReduction}% less damage and takes {damageTakenIncrease}% more damage.
trait.mastertrait.aegis.name: Aegis
trait.mastertrait.aegis.desc: {chance}% chance when blocking to heal {heal}. CD {cooldownSeconds:min}.
trait.mastertrait.stance.name: Stance
trait.mastertrait.stance.desc: Blocking reduces the next damage you take by {damageReduction}%.
trait.mastertrait.defiance.name: Defiance
trait.mastertrait.defiance.desc:
Each block grants +{toughnessPerBlock} armor toughness (max {maxToughness}).
Lost when you lower the shield or {resetSeconds}s pass without a block.
trait.mastertrait.kinetic_arsenal.name: Kinetic Arsenal
trait.mastertrait.kinetic_arsenal.desc: Blocked damage is stored. Your next attack deals {conversion}% of it as extra damage, then it resets.
trait.mastertrait.storm_reservoir.name: Storm Reservoir
trait.mastertrait.storm_reservoir.desc: Every {blocks} blocks, lightning strikes the attacker for {baseDamage} x (1 + Unbreaking level x {unbreakingScale}) damage.
trait.mastertrait.wonder_reflect.name: Wonder Reflect
trait.mastertrait.wonder_reflect.desc: {chance}% chance to reflect a blocked projectile back at {damageMultiplier}x damage.
trait.mastertrait.tanker_spirit.name: Tanker Spirit
trait.mastertrait.tanker_spirit.desc: Below {lowHealthBelow}% health, a successful block restores {healPercent}% max health. CD {cooldownSeconds:min}.
trait.mastertrait.hazard.name: Hazard
trait.mastertrait.hazard.desc: Blocking a hit inflicts Poison ({poisonSeconds}s) and Wither ({witherSeconds}s) on the attacker.
trait.mastertrait.echoing_blades.name: Echoing Blades
trait.mastertrait.echoing_blades.desc:
{chance}% chance on hit to strike a second time for {extraDamagePercent}% damage.
Deals {damagePenalty}% less damage.
trait.mastertrait.ruinous_cleave.name: Ruinous Cleave
trait.mastertrait.ruinous_cleave.desc:
{chance}% chance on hit to deal {multiplier}x damage.
-{criticalDamage}% Critical Damage.
trait.mastertrait.core_shaker.name: Core Shaker
trait.mastertrait.core_shaker.desc: Every hit builds a stack. At {hits} stacks, hostile mobs within {range} blocks take {baseDamage} damage, +{damagePerBreach} per level of Breach and +{damagePerMob} per hostile mob nearby.
trait.mastertrait.ethereal_steel.name: Ethereal Steel
trait.mastertrait.ethereal_steel.desc:
{chance}% chance on hit to ignore armor (-{chanceLossPerLevel}% per level of Sharpness, Smite and Bane of Arthropods).
-{damagePenalty}% damage, -{criticalChance}% Critical Chance, -{criticalDamage}% Critical Damage.
trait.mastertrait.sunscorched.name: Sunscorched
trait.mastertrait.dune_stalker.name: Dune Stalker
trait.mastertrait.dune_stalker.desc: While in deserts gain +{movementSpeed}% movement speed and +{attackSpeed}% attack speed.
trait.mastertrait.frostborn.name: Frostborn
trait.mastertrait.frostborn.desc: Immune to freezing. {chance}% chance on hit to inflict Slowness for {seconds}s.
trait.mastertrait.glacial_fang.name: Glacial Fang
trait.mastertrait.glacial_fang.desc:
In snowy biomes, attacks deal +{damage}% damage to enemies above {healthAbove}% health.
This weapon loses durability twice as fast.
trait.mastertrait.sharp_shooter.name: Sharp Shooter
trait.mastertrait.sharp_shooter.desc: Arrows deal +{damagePerBlock}% damage and gain +{armorPiercingPerBlock} Armor Piercing for every block between you and the target.
trait.mastertrait.oiled.name: Oiled
trait.mastertrait.oiled.desc: Arrows deal +{damage}% damage to burning targets and extend their burning by {extraFireSeconds}s per hit.
trait.mastertrait.rupture_shot.name: Rupture Shot
trait.mastertrait.rupture_shot.desc: Arrows deal +{damage}% damage to targets with armor (+{damagePerLevel}% damage and +{armorPiercingPerLevel} Armor Piercing per level of Critical Impact on this weapon).
trait.mastertrait.barrage.name: Barrage
trait.mastertrait.barrage.desc: {chance}% chance to fire one extra arrow right after the first. It ignores invulnerability frames, so both arrows hit.
trait.mastertrait.merciless.name: Merciless
trait.mastertrait.merciless.desc: Arrows deal +{damage}% damage to targets below {healthBelow}% health.
trait.mastertrait.overdraw.name: Overdraw
trait.mastertrait.overdraw.desc: An arrow released after drawing the bow for {seconds}s deals +{damage}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.deadly_spot.name: Deadly Spot
trait.mastertrait.fatal_trajectory.name: Fatal Trajectory
trait.mastertrait.fatal_trajectory.desc: Arrows deal +{damage}% damage to targets below {healthBelow}% health, with +{armorPiercingPerLevel} Armor Piercing per enchantment level on this weapon.
trait.mastertrait.marked.name: Marked
trait.mastertrait.marked.desc: Each hit on the same target grants +{damage}% damage (max +{maxDamage}%). Resets after {resetSeconds}s without hitting the target.
trait.mastertrait.quickdraw.name: Quickdraw
trait.mastertrait.quickdraw.desc: Reduces draw and load time by {drawSpeed}%.
trait.mastertrait.line_up.name: Line Up
trait.mastertrait.line_up.desc: Arrows pierce through up to {targets} targets.
trait.mastertrait.empowered.name: Empowered
trait.mastertrait.ricochet.name: Ricochet
trait.mastertrait.ricochet.desc: {chance}% chance for an arrow to bounce to another enemy within {range} blocks after hitting.
trait.mastertrait.venom_coating.name: Venom Coating
trait.mastertrait.venom_coating.desc: Hitting a poisoned target raises its poison level by 1. Arrows deal +{damagePerLevel}% damage per poison level on the target (max +{maxDamage}%).
trait.mastertrait.oblivion_bane.name: Oblivion Bane
trait.mastertrait.oblivion_bane.desc: Hitting a withered target inflicts Wither on hostile mobs within {range} blocks. Killing it deals {baseDamage} damage (+{damagePerLevel} per level of Power and Piercing) to hostile mobs within {range} blocks.
trait.mastertrait.overpowered.name: Overpowered
trait.mastertrait.overpowered.desc: Arrows that hit a mob deal {damage}% of that damage to hostile mobs within {range} blocks of the target.
trait.mastertrait.seraphic_judgement.des: Arrows deal +{damage}% damage to undead and Nether mobs. Critical Strike hits heal you for {critHeal}% of your max health.
trait.mastertrait.frenzy.name: Frenzy
trait.mastertrait.frenzy.desc: Each hit increases draw speed by {drawSpeedPerHit}% (max {maxDrawSpeed}%). Arrows deal {damagePenalty}% less damage. Resets after {resetSeconds}s without hitting.
trait.mastertrait.opening_shot.name: Opening Shot
trait.mastertrait.opening_shot.desc: Arrows deal +{damage}% damage to targets at full health.
trait.mastertrait.liquify.name: Liquify
trait.mastertrait.liquify.desc: Arrows keep their speed in water. While you are in water arrows deal +{damage}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.tight_string.name: Tight String
trait.mastertrait.tight_string.desc: Arrows deal +{damage}% damage. Draw and load speed -{drawSpeed}%.
trait.mastertrait.tailwind.name: Tailwind
trait.mastertrait.tailwind.desc: After an arrow hits, gain Speed I for {seconds}s. CD {cooldownSeconds:min}.
trait.mastertrait.behemoth_bane.name: Behemoth Bane
trait.mastertrait.behemoth_bane.desc: Arrows that hit a mob with {minMaxHealth}+ max health deal {fixedDamage} extra damage (+{damagePerLevel} per level of Power and Piercing).
trait.mastertrait.tri_shot.name: Tri-Shot
trait.mastertrait.predator.name: Predator
trait.mastertrait.predator.desc: Hitting a target {distance}+ blocks away grants +{criticalChance}% Critical Chance.
trait.mastertrait.shatterpoint.name: Shatterpoint
trait.mastertrait.shatterpoint.desc: Critical arrows ignore {armorIgnore}% of the target's armor.
trait.mastertrait.phoenixs_last_arrow.de: When your health falls below {healthBelow}%, your next arrow deals +{damage}% damage and restores {heal}% of your max health. CD {cooldownSeconds:min}.
trait.mastertrait.requiem_of_kings.name: Requiem of Kings
trait.mastertrait.requiem_of_kings.desc: Arrows deal +{damage}% damage to mobs with {minMaxHealth}+ max health. Killing one grants all players within {range} blocks +{buffDamage}% damage for {buffSeconds}s.
trait.mastertrait.dragon_slayer.name: Dragon Slayer
trait.mastertrait.dragon_slayer.desc: Deals +{damage}% damage to enemies with exactly {health1} or {health2} max health and you take {damageReduction}% less damage from them.
trait.mastertrait.royal_impaler.name: Royal Impaler
trait.mastertrait.royal_impaler.desc: Deals +{damage}% damage to targets above {healthAbove}% max health, otherwise -{penalty}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.sundering.name: Sundering
trait.mastertrait.sundering.desc: Trident attacks ignore {armorIgnore}% of the target's armor.
trait.mastertrait.coral_piercer.name: Coral Piercer
trait.mastertrait.coral_piercer.desc: Deals +{damage}% damage to targets with at least {healthMultiple}x your max health, otherwise -{criticalDamagePenalty}% Critical Damage.
trait.mastertrait.executioners_prong.des: Deals +{damage}% damage to targets below {healthBelow}% max health, otherwise -{penalty}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.relentless.name: Relentless
trait.mastertrait.relentless.desc: Each thrown trident hit grants +{damagePerHit}% damage, up to +{maxDamage}%. Resets after {resetSeconds}s without throwing.
trait.mastertrait.linebreaker.name: Linebreaker
trait.mastertrait.linebreaker.desc: Thrown tridents pierce one additional enemy, dealing {damage}% damage to it.
trait.mastertrait.blessed_origin_water.d: In rain gain +{damage}% damage, +{attackSpeed}% attack speed and +{damageReduction}% damage reduction. Doubled while in water.
trait.mastertrait.abyssal_reaver.name: Abyssal Reaver
trait.mastertrait.abyssal_reaver.desc: While underwater deals +{aquaticDamage}% damage to aquatic mobs and +{damage}% to others.
trait.mastertrait.glacial_undertow.name: Glacial Undertow
trait.mastertrait.glacial_undertow.desc: {chance}% chance on hit to slow the target for {seconds}s. Slowed targets take +{damage}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.stormblood.name: Stormblood
trait.mastertrait.stormblood.desc: Taking damage grants +{attackSpeedPerStack}% attack speed per stack, up to +{maxAttackSpeed}%, for {seconds}s.
trait.mastertrait.aegis_of_the_deep.name: Aegis of the Deep
trait.mastertrait.aegis_of_the_deep.desc: While in water gain Absorption for {seconds}s and take {flatReduction} less damage per hit. CD {cooldownSeconds:min}.
trait.mastertrait.thorned_trident.name: Thorned Trident
trait.mastertrait.thorned_trident.desc: Reflect {reflect}% of damage taken and gain +{knockbackResistance}% knockback resistance. After taking damage your next attack deals +{damage}% damage.
trait.mastertrait.unyielding_tide.name: Unyielding Tide
trait.mastertrait.unyielding_tide.desc: Killing an enemy gains {damageReduction}% damage reduction for {seconds}s.
trait.mastertrait.lightning_judgement.de: Every {hits}th trident hit calls {strikes} lightning strikes, each dealing {damage}% of the hit damage to enemies within {range} blocks.
trait.mastertrait.ocean_splitter.name: Ocean Splitter
trait.mastertrait.ocean_splitter.desc: Each second you charge a throw beyond {seconds}s adds +{damagePerSecond}% damage. Doubled in water.
trait.mastertrait.beastial.name: Beastial
tooltip.mastertrait.reroll_item: Can be used to reroll weapon traits.
tooltip.mastertrait.reroll_hidden_2: The new traits are revealed when you take the item.
